sources.entry: Gridfy - Quickly calculate column widths and get correct results for your grid.

summary.one_liner: Gridfy is a macOS app for calculating grid column and page widths so a site or application layout comes out correct.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a tool for calculating column widths and page widths for a layout grid. It shows error notifications when inputs are invalid and offers two result modes. It has dark and light appearance modes and smooth animations. The README says it works offline. It is listed as optimised for Macs with Apple Silicon and as working on macOS 13 Ventura. The README does not describe the input fields or the exact formulas used.
use_cases: calculate grid column widths for a website layout
work out page width for a design grid
check layout math offline on a Mac
prepare column sizes for an app interface
notable: Two result modes for column width output
Dark and light mode with smooth animation
caveats: Requires macOS; README names macOS 13 Ventura as a tested version
README gives no install or build instructions
README has no screenshots despite a heading for them
